steps.title: Initialize Project Structure
steps.description: Create the core project folders and placeholder files (index.html, style.css, script.js).

steps.title: Add Tailwind CSS CDN
steps.description: Link Tailwind CSS v4 via CDN in the HTML head to enable utility‑first styling.

steps.title: Create Header & Navigation
steps.description: Build a responsive navigation bar with brand logo and links to sections.

steps.title: Design Hero Section
steps.description: Add a full‑width hero image, headline, sub‑headline, and a primary CTA button.

steps.title: Showcase Featured Shoes
steps.description: Create a responsive grid displaying featured shoe products with images, names, and prices.

steps.title: Add Benefits / Features Section
steps.description: Highlight key selling points (comfort, style, durability) with icons and short descriptions.

steps.title: Insert Testimonials Carousel
steps.description: Show three customer testimonials with photos and ratings; simple slide animation via CSS.

steps.title: Create Footer
steps.description: Add a footer containing quick links, social icons, and copyright information.

steps.title: Write Custom CSS
steps.description: Add a few custom Tailwind layers for smooth scroll behavior and minor overrides.

steps.title: Add Interactive JavaScript
steps.description: Implement smooth scrolling for navigation links and a simple mobile menu toggle.

steps.title: Optimize Assets & Accessibility
steps.description: Add alt attributes, aria‑labels, and ensure color contrast meets WCAG AA.

steps.title: Building ShoeSphere Landing Page
steps.description: Compile all files, run a final visual check, and deliver the complete landing page.
